title: Cosmic Arc II
tagline: Poach rare creatures across a dying star cluster: an Atari 7800 game for the AstroCart
ready: Press Z to start. Click or press a key for sound.
controls: Button 1: fire, choose, the tractor beam
Button 2: the fighter, the next page or tab, drop cargo
[↑] [↓] [←] [→] move the bar or the chart's cursor, [Z] chooses, [X] the next page
aim with the arrows, [Z] fires, [X] launches or recalls the fighter
hold [↓] to drop the shuttle, [Z] the beam, push [↑] under the Ark to dock
about: Generations ago the Cosmic Ark finished its rescue and was sealed away. You found it. Now its tractor beam serves the black market: chart a new 64-sector galaxy every voyage, beam rare creatures off doomed worlds, defend the Ark from asteroids, raiders and gunships, and trade at eleven starports.
Built for the AstroCart: its math unit flies the ships and its two POKEY chips play the music. Your voyages are kept in the browser, as on a SaveKey.
